verdict.rationale: ADK ships versioned releases with a 2.0 migration page that lists per-language breaking changes and deprecations, including runtime deprecation warnings, along with 1.x pinning guidance, Go major-version module paths and per-feature version badges. The vendor's own docs say this versioning practice is demonstrated rather than promised: there is no semver commitment and no deprecation-window policy page. Missing for 10: a formal documented deprecation policy with support windows, an explicit semver/API stability commitment, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: the 2.0 page enumerates per-language breaking changes and deprecations (e.g. deprecated workflow agent classes that log "a deprecation warning once per class, per process"), pinning guidance for staying on 1.x, and Go's major-version module path
